name: lightcraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for LightCraft: develop photos and raw files (auto tone, white balance, 114 sliders, presets, profiles, masks, spot healing, crop), merge HDR and panoramas, cull by sharpness and export JPEG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, AVIF and DNG with LightCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . lightcraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)

codex.shortDescription: Develop photos and raw files with your local LightCraft
defaultPrompt: Auto-tone every raw photo in this folder and export JPEGs
Merge these bracketed shots into an HDR and export a TIFF
Give these portraits a warm black-and-white look
